A.deploy: plain deploy; engine sets 8 switches (ADAPT_NOWAIT CPU_IQ_ALL_EXACT1 SIDE_MIXER ATTN_DAILY GR_UP75 GU_SWIGLU QSA_ROWS B6_MMVQ_ROWS), STRATA_ADAPT_LAG=2 explicit

B.deploy: deploy --condition condition-sm86-perf-0.json; STRATA_SM86_PERF=0 turns the 8 off, STRATA_ADAPT_LAG=2 explicit and kept

workload: same as pool-workers: benchmarks/resource-calibration-v1/workload.py build(787), three requests, cases SHA fixed in the reused driver
per_block: same as pool-workers (reused run_block): deploy on condition change, cold load, one unscored warm-up pass, measured three requests, stop; then the engine log's switch announcement is checked against the condition (A: exactly the 8, B: none)
metric: block-level B/A engine output and engine input tok/s on adjacent block pairs (6 pairs); per-request ratios reported too
threshold: for engine output or engine input: |median pair ratio - 1| >= 2% with >= 5/6 pairs in the same direction = meaningful difference; otherwise no meaningful difference
extension: if a metric's median ratio is within 1%-3% of 1 and pair directions are mixed (<5/6), add BAAB (4 blocks, 2 pairs) once; then judge on 8 pairs with >= 7/8 same direction
correctness_and_identity: per-request pass (frozen expected answer) for every block; output consistency = common prefix length of the full reasoning+content text between block pairs, within A, within B and across A-B (greedy outputs already differ between loads of one condition: pool-workers run shows 6 distinct outputs per request per condition). The switches are labelled exact upstream; a cross-condition prefix clearly shorter than within-condition, or any correctness drop in B, is reported separately
stop: 12 blocks (or the extension) complete; restore plain deploy at any exit; engine output < 60 tok/s, timeouts and load failures are recorded as incidents
driver: run.py (imports the pool-workers driver's workload/run_block/groups unchanged)
